title: Checkpoint leaves a tick at 'integrated' after the tracker closed it
description:
From the ticks pwp run, 2026-09-15 (close-out tick 8vl, attempt 13). Verified directly on origin/epic/pwp:

  checkpoint.json          tracker (.tick/issues)
    azq  closed              azq  closed
    nkf  closed              nkf  closed
    3r2  closed              3r2  closed
    hvj  closed              hvj  closed
    os6  closed              os6  closed
    gms  INTEGRATED          gms  CLOSED
    sx5  closed              sx5  closed
    8vl  rejected            8vl  in_progress

gms merged, its gate passed, the run published the close and the tracker records it closed — the feed shows closed at 06:12:57 and cleaned_up after. The checkpoint row never advanced past 'integrated'.

Every sibling that took the same path reads 'closed', so this is a missed transition on one tick rather than a design gap. Likely relevant: gms is the tick whose run process died mid-close earlier in the session, so the suspicion is that the close-to-checkpoint transition is not idempotent across a restart — the tracker close was already published, so the resumed run had nothing to do and never wrote the row. Prove that before repairing it.

Impact is small today and real tomorrow: the checkpoint is what a resumed run reads to decide what is done, so a tick stuck at 'integrated' is a tick a future resume may try to finish again.

ROUTING NOTE: the finding that reported this (6a3af0d8) was promoted onto tick 54n by mistake — 54n is the closeout boundary defect from the same attempt. This tick is the real home for it; 54n carries a pointer back here.
acceptance_criteria: A run whose process dies between publishing a tick's close and writing its checkpoint row leaves both consistent on resume, proven by a test that kills the run in that window and asserts the checkpoint reads closed
